judgmentPolicy: AST violations, finite scenario counterexamples and unresolved business interpretations are distinct. Missing a particular syntax pattern is not proof of missing business behavior. Multiple error categories may apply to one contract.

categories.name: Requirement obligation omitted
categories.ast: An unbound issued variable or invalid scope can be established, but absence of taskEvidence/particular AST syntax does not prove semantic omission.
categories.oracle: A frozen scenario that requires the missing effect/result can supply a finite counterexample.
categories.unresolved: Completeness against all NL obligations without verified semantic annotations.

categories.name: Incorrect Pre/Post placement or excessive guard
categories.ast: Illegal result or @pre scope and unsupported side effects in P are deterministically checkable within the supported language.
categories.oracle: Rejecting a valid invocation or accepting an invalid one can expose misclassification or extra restrictions.
categories.unresolved: Whether a well-typed guard belongs in P rather than a conditional Q without source/behavior interpretation.

categories.name: Conditional branch or trigger scope lost
categories.ast: Malformed/unsupported branch syntax is checkable; alternative equivalent Boolean encodings must not be rejected for lacking if.
categories.oracle: Positive and negative branch scenarios can expose dropped effects, wrong return or treating a branch guard as a global precondition.
categories.unresolved: Unexercised branch space or ambiguous trigger meaning.

categories.name: Wrong business target identity
categories.ast: Actual lexical binding, shadowing, undeclared references and incompatible types are checkable. Same model type/name does not prove same business instance.
categories.oracle: Distinct target and distractor objects with identity-sensitive assertions can expose wrong lookup/return/update.
categories.unresolved: Query equivalence or identifier predicate meaning inferred only from NL and a type-correct AST.

categories.name: Created object and later usage disagree
categories.ast: Undefined/out-of-scope binding or incompatible created-object use is checkable.
categories.oracle: Object identity, instance inclusion and later link/current/result assertions can expose using a different object.
categories.unresolved: Whether two independently well-typed creations/queries denote the intended object without behavioral evidence.

categories.name: Inconsistent formal parameter use
categories.ast: Resolution to a declaration and type compatibility are checkable. Property spelling is not a formal parameter identity proof.
categories.oracle: Different parameter values and explicit arithmetic/assignment assertions can expose substitutions or off-by-one use.
categories.unresolved: Correct use of a well-typed value/expression without independently specified behavior.

categories.name: Incorrect pre/post-state update
categories.ast: Illegal @pre position or unsupported state access is checkable; omission of @pre alone is not proof of an incorrect state equation.
categories.oracle: Nontrivial pre-state values, multiplicity/boundary cases and expected post-state can expose bad updates.
categories.unresolved: General equivalence of a well-typed update to an NL arithmetic obligation.

categories.name: Locally valid expressions but behaviorally wrong whole contract
categories.ast: Cross-clause unresolved names, type conflicts and temporal/result scope conflicts are deterministically checkable.
categories.oracle: A complete candidate may pass syntax/type/PreExec but fail frozen behavioral scenarios; record actual counterexample.
categories.unresolved: Universal contract correctness, D/P/Q consistency and full NL entailment from structural checks alone.
